input: Find summer camps held at colleges and universities (athletics, academics, arts) open to kids for kids and teens in Madison, Yancey, Mitchell, McDowell and Rutherford counties, NC, and Johnson City, TN. Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: Mars Hill University summer camps 2026 youth
Appalachian Institute Creative Learning summer 2026 Mars Hill

candidates.name: Mars Hill University
candidates.note: Youth athletics camps and summer music camp; the music camp ran June 14–19, 2026.

candidates.name: PGC Basketball
candidates.note: Basketball camp at Mars Hill University for incoming grades 9–12; June 29–July 3, 2026.

candidates.name: Mars Hill Cycling Camps
candidates.note: Six-day junior cycling camps, ages 10–18; June–July 2027 sessions announced.

candidates.name: Fellowship of Christian Athletes
candidates.note: Team football camp at Mars Hill University for grades 9–12; June 11–13, 2026.

candidates.name: Appalachian Institute for Creative Learning
candidates.note: Ages 8–18 enrichment camp listed at Mars Hill in 2026; its current official page now names Berea, Kentucky.

candidates.name: Mayland Community College
candidates.note: Youth summer classes include firefighting and Junior Space Ranger; Burnsville space camp ran July 14–17, 2025.

candidates.name: Isothermal Community College
candidates.note: 2026 Discovery Engineering and Patriot Basketball camps, plus a summer bridge program for new high-school graduates.

candidates.name: McDowell County Schools
candidates.note: Camp Opportunity for rising grades 7–9 visits McDowell Technical Community College; manufacturing camp ran in 2025.

candidates.name: East Tennessee State University
candidates.note: Renaissance Child, applied STEM, bluegrass, pharmacy, nursing and athletics camps; several programs have 2027 dates.

candidates.name: Universal Cheerleaders Association
candidates.note: Junior-high and high-school cheer camp in ETSU dorms; July 11–14, 2026.

candidates.name: Milligan University
candidates.note: Near Johnson City; 2026 co-ed basketball camps for ages 7–17, with baseball and summer swimming also listed.

candidates.name: Lifeway FUGE Camps
candidates.note: Youth residential Christian camps at Milligan University near Johnson City; 2026 sessions documented.
